antipatterns: Do NOT edit PROJECT-STATE.md directly — edit project-state.json
Do NOT use agentType in workflows — use briefedAgent() with role from config
Do NOT tell agents to read files — inject content excerpts via Discovery → briefedAgent(contextExcerpts)
Do NOT ship code without AES ≥ 80 — quality violations block commit
Do NOT run full test suite in pipeline — Marcus uses targeted tests only
Do NOT merge to main after verify FAIL — merge is guarded on verify pass
Do NOT wrap bash commands in LLM agents — batch multiple bash ops into one agent call
Do NOT re-implement on prove UNPROVEN — UNPROVEN for CODE-only/LIGHT means prove can't add signal
Do NOT spawn agents for git push, echo, mkdir, cat — these are bash, not LLM work
